primary.title: The Wright Brothers' Flying Machine and How It Flies
primary.author: Orville Wright
primary.rationale: A detailed explanation of their aircraft and its mechanics, offering direct insight into their engineering principles and understanding of flight.

primary.title: How We Invented the Airplane
primary.author: Orville Wright
primary.rationale: A retrospective account by one of the brothers, providing personal narrative and historical context for their invention.

primary.title: The Papers of Wilbur and Orville Wright
primary.author: Wilbur Wright and Orville Wright
primary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of their correspondence, notebooks, and other documents, offering unparalleled primary source material on their work and thoughts.

secondary.title: The Wright Brothers: A Biography
secondary.author: Fred C. Kelly
secondary.rationale: While pre-1976, this is considered a foundational biography by a contemporary and friend of the Wrights, often cited in later scholarship. Later editions might be available.

secondary.title: First Flight: The Story of the Wright Brothers
secondary.author: George Tucker
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive account of the Wright brothers' lives and achievements, likely to be a well-researched narrative.

secondary.title: The Wright Brothers: Pioneers of the Air
secondary.author: David McCullough
secondary.rationale: A highly acclaimed and accessible biography by a renowned historian, offering a modern scholarly perspective on their lives and impact.

suggestions.notes: The primary sources are largely collections of their writings and papers. For secondary sources, David McCullough's work is a prominent recent scholarly biography. Fred C. Kelly's biography, though older, is a significant early work. George Tucker's book is also a comprehensive historical account.
